name: discount-field
title: Discount field
description: A discount as either an amount or a percentage, with the switch inside the field and the resulting price shown against the original.
docs: A text field with a two-sided switch in it: your currency code ('EUR') and '%'. The number is read the way the switch says, and each side keeps its own number, so flipping never loses what was typed. value is { type: 'amount', value } in minor units or { type: 'percent', value } as a plain number, or null for an empty field; control it with value and onValueChange, or start it with defaultValue and defaultType. onValueChange gets null while the field is empty or the discount is refused, so a form never holds an impossible one. Pass price (minor units) and the field prints 'New price 38.40 EUR, 20% off' under itself (the percentage is worked out for an amount), and refuses an amount above the price or a percentage above maxPercent (100) in words, marking the input invalid. A comma or a point both work as the decimal separator, and the number is tidied when the field is left. name adds two hidden inputs for a plain form post: the number under name and its type under name-type. The switch is a radio group named 'Discount type' with arrow keys. locale writes the numbers, hideLabel keeps the label for screen readers only and labels holds the fixed words.
